messages:
Elena Park: FYI — BigWave Corp says the enterprise promo credit from their PO never hit their account. Sales added a PO note in the contract that seems to be blocking automated application. Customer is seeing an error in the billing UI and when they call the API to list credits.

Elena Park: PO: BW-45321, Contract: BW-2024-09, promo amount: $150,000 (one-time). Sales note on PO: 'apply after invoice approval' (literal text). They want this applied now as a manual grant while invoicing is finalized.

Jordan Lee: thanks — can you paste the exact error the customer sees (screenshot or API response)? Also did sales already send written approval to finance?

Elena Park: sending the API repro from the customer environment — they did a GET /v1/credits and then a POST to /v1/credits/apply with the promo code. curl snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-enterprise-xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"promo_code":"BW-ENT-CONTRACT-150K","po_number":"BW-45321"}'
```

Response: 
```json
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
{
  "error": {
    "code": "promo_locked_by_po_note",
    "message": "Promo is restricted by PO note or contract clause: 'apply after invoice approval'",
    "details": {"po_number":"BW-45321","contract_id":"BW-2024-09"}
  }
}
```

Elena Park: customer also sees a tooltip in the billing UI: "Promo blocked by PO note: contact your sales rep." They expect a manual adjustment ASAP.

Ravi Patel: okay. From finance side this looks like a contract constraint enforcement we added last quarter. We can do a manual ledger credit but need: (1) sales written approval email, (2) scanned PO showing the note, (3) internal approval in the billing ticket. Please attach those. Once we have them I can create a manual credit entry (GL: deferred_revenue_adj) and link to invoice. ETA ~1 business day after docs.

Maeve Torres: Jordan — we verbally told them we'd accommodate until invoicing is done. I'll post the email thread approving the manual grant in 10m. We want to avoid churn. :+1:

Jordan Lee: linking the authorization here — I confirm Sales approved a one-time manual credit for $150k contingent on receiving the signed PO scan. Posting snippet of my message to the customer: "We will apply the credit manually now; finance will reconcile with your invoice once signed."

Samira Khan: digging into the codepath for that error. The 'promo_locked_by_po_note' is surfaced by the billing-microservice policy check. It blocks both UI and API apply endpoints. For a quick workaround we can bypass the check for internal manual grants, but we should not change the public API behavior. Ravi — when you do the ledger adjustment, can you also set credit.source = "manual-sales-grant" so telemetry differentiates it?

Ravi Patel: yes we'll tag it. Also need the ticket number in the description so ops can audit.

Elena Park: attached the signed PO scan (BW-45321_signed.pdf) and the Sales approval email thread. Putting them in the ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/CS-98712 

FinanceBot: Manual credit request CS-98712 received. Workflow ID: WF-67298. Assigned to Ravi Patel.

Ravi Patel: I have everything I need. Creating ledger adjustment now. Will post transaction id when complete.

Samira Khan: FYI for engineering backlog — we should add a more descriptive admin error in the console explaining what docs finance needs, and a link to initiate a manual grant request. I'll open an issue.

Ravi Patel: Manual ledger credit created. Transaction ID: LEDGER-2024-000887. Amount: $150,000. GL account: deferred_revenue_adj. Credit tagged: ["manual-sales-grant","BW-45321","CS-98712"].

Ravi Patel: I also added a comment to the contract record noting the manual application and that finance will reconcile on invoice.

Elena Park: confirmed with BigWave that the credit shows up in their account balance and they can see it in the UI. Customer response: "Thanks, appreciate the quick help." :white_check_mark:

Jordan Lee: closing loop — Sales will finalize invoice signature this week and notify finance. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

Samira Khan: created issue ENG-PLAT-1453 to improve admin flows and the error text.

Elena Park: marking thread resolved from CS side. If any follow-ups (reconciliation mismatch) please ping me.

Ravi Patel: note for records — keep CS-98712 open until invoice reconciliation is complete.

Elena Park: noted, leaving ticket open. Thanks all. :rocket:
